implemented.summary: Optional user-triggered local multimodal PNG inference through configured loopback server; no automatic weights, external calls or tools. Low-level sensing remains independent of model interpretation.
implemented.origin: explicit uploaded PNG or one-shot user-permission camera/screen snapshot
implemented.model_transport: loopback HTTP chat-completions with base64 image_url part, bounded tokens/time; actual model server behavior not attested
implemented.media_retention: no raw-media persistence by Studio; local model/server logging not attested

science.question: Can an explicitly configured local multimodal model produce useful, grounded scene descriptions compared with held-out human-labeled references without side effects?
science.baseline: low-level deterministic PNG features do not establish semantics
science.hypothesis: vision-capable model improves object/spatial description on fixed labeled sample compared with feature-only baseline
science.null: unsupported model or no model weights yields failure, never fabricated caption
science.falsifier: hallucinations, low baseline advantage, invalid image acceptance, unauthorized model endpoint or tool calls
science.metric: blind-scored grounded descriptions and false positive count
science.unit: per-image human-checked items, latency ms, bytes sent
science.evaluation: predeclare held-out image set, test standard and adversarial negative examples, blind assessor independent of generation
science.current_evidence_class: source and synthetic HTTP fixture only
competing_mechanisms: model is text-only and ignores image

n_ality.test: source/data identity never collapsed with unverified caption

continuum.reason: No time/pose-based field model or measured interpolation

fuzzy.reason: Heuristic salience distinct from Boolean consent/privacy/promotion gates
